title: Four materials, four sounds: one material-free prompt, and MiniMax H3 Hyper's sound follows the dominoes at $0.15 a take
blurb: One domino run in wood, glass, ice and paper, animated by MiniMax H3 Hyper from a single prompt that never names a material — each take's generated sound matches what the dominoes are made of, about 15 cents a take.

title: A single product photo, spun a full 360° with no visible seam, looping endlessly on a shop page, then raised to 60 fps
blurb: One product picture becomes a seamless 360° turntable loop — the looping model ends the spin exactly on its first frame, then an upscale pass lifts it to 60 fps for a shop page.

title: A 3D knight that walks, sliced into a sprite stack you can read
blurb: An iron temple knight, rigged by Idol Max, then cut into pixel slices with Slice 3D and stacked back into a walking sprite — composited into a ruined temple, chest of gold and all.

title: Cast, set, prop: three pictures go in, a three-shot scene with sound comes out, about $0.17 a shot
blurb: Three FLUX.3 Klein pictures — a tin robot, a rainy windowsill, a paper boat — become three MiniMax H3 Hyper shots (wide, medium, close-up) with their own stereo rain and the same cast in every frame: $0.1736 a shot, no start frames drawn.

title: Pull a clipped sunset down six stops and the SDR sun just goes grey while the HDR version keeps a bright disc, all for 78 cents on Nanoodle
blurb: A clipped-white lighthouse sunset, remastered to HDR with LTX-2.5: pull it down six stops and the SDR sun greys out while the HDR disc still burns, 7.2 stops above SDR white — 78 cents.

title: One sentence, one walking fox, $0.38: Idol Max rigs a 3D character on Nanoodle
blurb: One sentence becomes a painted cartoon fox, then a rigged 3D character with walk, run, jump and idle clips — FLUX.3 Klein plus Idol Max, about 93 seconds and 38 cents.

title: Watch a glass of water fall for 16 smooth seconds: Nanoodle's first slow-mo graph, with sound, for 21 cents
blurb: A 4-second clip of a falling glass becomes a smooth 16-second slow-mo with synced sound effects — Topaz interpolation plus ElevenLabs SFX in one graph, about 21 cents a run.

title: Play GRIMPACK in your browser: a booster-pack tower defense whose art came from Nanoodle
blurb: Every image in this gothic arena game — the grave-knight, the horrors, the towers, the key art — came out of Nanoodle workflows, $1.18 of a $5 budget all-in. Play it free, watch the trailer, see the graphs.

title: One picture, a Gaussian splat and a 3D mesh for 21 cents
blurb: A knitted witch-hat pumpkin becomes an Idol splat and a TRELLIS.2 mesh. See the real results, costs and flaws.

title: One 480p flying car through three 1080p upscalers for 60 cents
blurb: FlashVSR, SeedVR2 and P-Video upscale the same draft side by side. The clock tower still tells two different times.

title: A dragon sticker becomes an editable SVG for 18 cents
blurb: FLUX.3 Klein paints a sticker; Ideogram Vector makes an SVG that stays sharp at 8×, with more colours than requested.

title: Song in, music video out: a 61-cent tin robot that dances to its own track
blurb: Feed in a song, get back a music video: a tin robot dancing to its own track for 61 cents, chorus cut.

title: Noon to midnight in one take: a paper-craft village sunset for 42 cents
blurb: 42 cents for a paper-craft village going noon to midnight in one take, the sunset lands right on the night shot.

title: Glass, watercolor, photo: one coffee grinder in three looks for 3.3 cents
blurb: Three looks of one coffee grinder (glass, watercolor, photo) for 3.3 cents, gears included.

title: Four reference pics, one cozy owl, 5 cents
blurb: Mixing four reference pictures for 5 cents keeps the owl on-model.

title: One brief, four image models, 32 cents: which one follows your copy?
blurb: 4 models, one prompt, 32 cents, see which one actually listens.

title: A treasure chest GLB from one sentence for 21 cents
blurb: Type one sentence, get a textured GLB treasure chest for 21 cents, with the mesh's shortcuts called out up front.

title: One product photo, more angles: a 90° mug orbit for 26 cents
blurb: A stoneware mug orbited 90 degrees from one product photo for 26 cents, plus where the workflow falls short.

title: An indie pop song for 18 cents
blurb: Nanoodle's sing flow turns a prompt into a full indie pop song for 18 cents.
